ai_briefing.morning_summary: Major cryptos posted modest gains, with BTC up 0.74% and ETH up 1.16%, keeping the market on a mild upward trajectory. However, a wave of regulatory and operational news—from the Philippines central bank eyeing Coins.ph to Binance winding down its mining pool—adds caution. Tokenized finance activity continues to grow, highlighted by BNY and Citadel’s Treasury tests and increased Solana/BNB Chain stock trading.
